Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 1.6.0 (THE CASINO IS OPEN)

- The Casino on Ashfall Isle is open! Walk through the glowing doors into a huge golden hall with chandeliers, red carpet, neon signs, dealers and regulars. It is a SAFE ZONE: nothing can hurt you inside.
- SLOTS: six machines along the wall. Line up three 7s for 100x your bet. Auto-spin included.
- BLACKJACK: hit, stand or double down against the dealer. Blackjack pays 3 to 2.
- ROULETTE: bet on a number (36x), red/black, odd/even, high/low or a dozen, and watch the wheel spin.
- WHEEL OF FORTUNE: one FREE spin every in-game day. Win cash, buffs, materials, or the JACKPOT.
- THE BAR: drinks that give you buffs (luck, damage, speed, defence, fireproof). Water is on the house.
- Bet with chips from $100 up to $10M, or go MAX.
